title: Watch the agent film itself working
summary: Starts a screen recording, drives a browser on this desktop, stops, and leaves you an MP4.

steps.note: Start filming this desktop — a red RECORDING marker appears
Open a page — this one needs your permission
Go somewhere else — it asks again, every time, for now
Read the page the way the agent does
Go back — allowed without asking, because it cannot reach anywhere new
Stop filming and close the file
